summary: Show image preparation and distinguish unstarted Core containers from probe failures
details: Expose the current image group and cumulative preparation time in up and independent status observers, including slow pulls before any container exists. Ignore records from exited processes or previous configurations.
Show WAITING for native Core and its background history only when Docker confirms the container has not started; preserve inventory, probe and container failure observations.
Package the display helper and add slow-pull, independent-observer and startup-wait regressions plus operator guidance.
operator_actions: Use controller logs --follow to inspect image-layer transfers and retries; elapsed preparation time alone does not prove download progress.

Install and activate a release containing this fix to use the updated tools. The image preparation stage is recorded by subsequent up operations; an already running older controller does not emit this record.
